title: Mathematical Modeling for Chemical and Food Engineering - companion code
description: Python and MATLAB scripts accompanying the textbook Mathematical Modeling for Chemical and Food Engineering by G. Lamberti: numerical solution of algebraic, ordinary and partial differential equations, parameter estimation, optimization, design of experiments, response surfaces and machine learning, with case histories from chemical and food process engineering.

creators.name: Lamberti, Gaetano
creators.affiliation: University of Salerno, Department of Industrial Engineering
